2608.10963.title: REAP: Relation-Aware Elicitation and Parsing for Closed-Book Knowledge Base Construction from LLMs
2608.10963.paper_summary: We present the REAP system for the AKBC Shared Task 2026 on constructing knowledge bases from language models in a closed-book setting, subject to a budget of at most 32B parameters and no model fine-tuning. Our system combines structured chain-of-thought reasoning, relation-specific query strategies, and a reasoning-based empty-set gate to elicit parametric knowledge, followed by direct extraction into valid JSON arrays. On the test set, the system, built on the Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 model, achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.62, with particularly strong results on countryLandBordersCountry (F1 = 0.95), companyTradesAtStockExchange (F1 = 0.73), and hasArea (F1 = 0.77). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yammdd/AKBC-Shared-Task-2026.
2608.10963.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了REAP系統，針對2026年AKBC共享任務，目的是在封閉書籍環境中從語言模型構建知識庫，並受到最多32B參數的預算限制，且不進行模型微調。<lb/>我們的系統結合了結構化的思考鏈推理、特定關係的查詢策略，以及基於推理的空集合閘門，以引出參數知識，然後直接提取為有效的JSON數組。<lb/>在測試集上，該系統基於Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501模型，達到了0.62的宏觀F1分數，特別是在countryLandBordersCountry（F1 = 0.95）、companyTradesAtStockExchange（F1 = 0.73）和hasArea（F1 = 0.77）上表現強勁。<lb/>我們的代碼可在https://github.com/yammdd/AKBC-Shared-Task-2026公開獲得。
